note: Main-path lines are from 05_PROLOGUE_PRODUCTION.md. Lines marked (placeholder) are stand-ins to be rewritten. Step types: line, choice, set_flag, join, key_item, quest.

P00_wake.speaker: narrator
P00_wake.text: A rail bell rings somewhere in a dark forest.

P00_wake.speaker: narrator
P00_wake.text: A train rushes past. Someone hums a lullaby. Two small shapes sit under a tree...

P00_wake.speaker: reno
P00_wake.text: A train! I almost caught it!

P00_wake.speaker: reno
P00_wake.text: Why do my best dreams always end before the exciting part?

P00_wake.speaker: reno
P00_wake.text: Today's the day. I'm going to see a real human train!

P00_wake.speaker: narrator
P00_wake.text: Reno picks up his old railway token.

P00_wake.speaker: reno
P00_wake.text: My lucky token. Nenek says I had it when she found me.

P00_wake.speaker: reno
P00_wake.text: She also says I shouldn't ask too many questions. Which is a very suspicious thing to say.

P01_lumi_joins.speaker: lumi
P01_lumi_joins.text: For the ridiculous plan you made yesterday.

P01_lumi_joins.speaker: lumi
P01_lumi_joins.text: You told everyone you were going to ride one.

P01_lumi_joins.speaker: reno
P01_lumi_joins.text: Only Bobo, Pak Gema, the mushroom seller, the beetles...

P01_lumi_joins.speaker: reno
P01_lumi_joins.text: I may have made a tactical mistake.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: That's what you said before we fell into the mushroom pond.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: You promised that before the mushroom pond, too.

then.speaker: lumi
then.text: You don't even know how human money works.

P01_lumi_joins.speaker: lumi
P01_lumi_joins.text: Something has been calling to me from beyond the forest. I want to know what it is.

P01_lumi_joins.speaker: reno
P01_lumi_joins.text: Then it's settled! A great adventure!

nenek_no_lumi.speaker: nenek
nenek_no_lumi.text: Reno. Lumi was looking for you by the great root. Go and find her. (placeholder)

P02_nenek.speaker: nenek
P02_nenek.text: Why are you carrying a travel bag?

P02_nenek.speaker: nenek
P02_nenek.text: And why is Lumi carrying a map?

P02_nenek.speaker: nenek
P02_nenek.text: The old crossings are not toys. They were sealed for a reason.

P02_nenek.speaker: nenek
P02_nenek.text: One you're not ready to understand.

P02_nenek.speaker: lumi
P02_nenek.text: Then how will we ever understand it?

nenek_after.speaker: nenek
nenek_after.text: Patience, little ones. The forest remembers everything. (placeholder)

P03_bobo.speaker: bobo
P03_bobo.text: Welcome, welcome! Everything is reasonably priced!

P03_bobo.speaker: lumi
P03_bobo.text: That's not what your sign says.

P03_bobo.speaker: bobo
P03_bobo.text: One lantern. Very rare. Extremely precious.

P03_bobo.speaker: bobo
P03_bobo.text: But a Leafling ran off with my parcel into the Training Glade. Bring it back and the lantern is yours. (placeholder)

bobo_waiting.speaker: bobo
bobo_waiting.text: My parcel! Training Glade! South of Root Square. Hurry, hurry! (placeholder)

P03_bobo_return.speaker: bobo
P03_bobo_return.text: A deal is a deal. One antique lantern, and two Dewdrop Candies for being brave. (placeholder)

bobo_after.speaker: bobo
bobo_after.text: Come back any time! Prices are reasonable on Tuesdays. (placeholder)

glade_need_nenek.speaker: lumi
glade_need_nenek.text: Wait. Nenek Rimba wanted to see us first. Elder's Hollow is to the north. (placeholder)

glade_need_bobo.speaker: lumi
glade_need_bobo.text: We still need a lantern. Bobo's stall is in Root Market, east of here. (placeholder)

P04_leafling.speaker: reno
P04_leafling.text: Then why is it wearing the parcel?

P04_after.speaker: reno
P04_after.text: Did you see that? We were incredible!

P04_after.speaker: lumi
P04_after.text: It's running away with half a biscuit.

roots_too_dark.speaker: lumi
roots_too_dark.text: It's pitch dark down there. We need a lantern first. Bobo has one. (placeholder)

pz1_hint.speaker: narrator
pz1_hint.text: Gaps in the roots, marked with old gold paint.

pz1_hint.speaker: lumi
pz1_hint.text: Reno, you could Leaf Leap these. Face a gap and press A. (placeholder)

leap_lumi.speaker: lumi
leap_lumi.text: I can float a little, but not that far. Reno could leap it. (Press C to swap.)

leap_too_far.speaker: reno
leap_too_far.text: Even I can't leap that far.

fall.speaker: narrator
fall.text: Down into the roots... and back up again.

pz2_hint.speaker: narrator
pz2_hint.text: A stone humming with a faint blue light.

pz2_hint.speaker: reno
pz2_hint.text: It's humming. Lumi might understand it. (Lead with Lumi: press C.)

PZ2_echo_sight.speaker: narrator
PZ2_echo_sight.text: Lumi listens to the stone. Its echo shows a path across the water.

PZ2_echo_sight.speaker: lumi
PZ2_echo_sight.text: Nothing. Perhaps it was the wind.

pz2_done.speaker: narrator
pz2_done.text: The stepping stones still glow faintly.

pz3_hint.speaker: narrator
pz3_hint.text: A mossy stone. Just moss... for now. (placeholder)

PZ3_gate_key.speaker: narrator
PZ3_gate_key.text: The echo trail ends here. Something glints under the moss.

P05_bridge.speaker: narrator
P05_bridge.text: A broken bridge. The chasm is far too wide.

pz4_hint.speaker: reno
pz4_hint.text: Roots everywhere, but where should they go?

pz4_hint.speaker: lumi
pz4_hint.text: Let me look first. (Lead with Lumi and check the post.)

PZ4_bridge_echo.speaker: narrator
PZ4_bridge_echo.text: Lumi traces the bridge's echo. A faint outline of the old bridge hangs over the chasm.

PZ4_bridge_echo.speaker: lumi
PZ4_bridge_echo.text: There! That's where it was. Reno, grab the roots and pull! (Swap to Reno.)

pz4_lumi_wait.speaker: lumi
pz4_lumi_wait.text: I can see it. Now Reno needs to pull the roots along the echo.

PZ4_root_grip.speaker: narrator
PZ4_root_grip.text: Reno pulls. The roots stretch along the echo and weave into a bridge.

P06_thornkeeper.speaker: reno
P06_thornkeeper.text: We only want to see a train!

P06_thornkeeper.speaker: reno
P06_thornkeeper.text: Can we give it a new one?

P06_thornkeeper.speaker: lumi
P06_thornkeeper.text: Not while it's trying to squash us.

P06_thornkeeper.speaker: reno
P06_thornkeeper.text: So... first we don't get squashed?

P06_after.speaker: narrator
P06_after.text: The Thornkeeper sinks back into the roots.

pz5_sealed.speaker: narrator
pz5_sealed.text: A great gate of woven roots. Something guards it.

pz5_need_key.speaker: narrator
pz5_need_key.text: The gate has an old keyhole.

pz5_need_key.speaker: lumi
pz5_need_key.text: The key must be somewhere in the Whispering Roots.

PZ5_open_gate.speaker: narrator
PZ5_open_gate.text: Reno turns the Gate Key. The roots unwind, and the air beyond shimmers like a curtain.

pz5_open.speaker: narrator
pz5_open.text: The open gate shimmers. The human world is on the other side.

P07_arrival.speaker: narrator
P07_arrival.text: Morning. A warm riverside village. A bicycle rattles past.

P07_arrival.speaker: lumi
P07_arrival.text: Only if you ride it into a wall.

P07_arrival.speaker: narrator
P07_arrival.text: A bus roars by in a cloud of dust.

P07_arrival.speaker: lumi
P07_arrival.text: I suspect our short visit is about to become much longer.
